hint: tap anywhere to shake the mango tree

game.q: he ties the cane and leaps back. what goes wrong?
opts: the troop stops for one last mango
the cane falls short of the tree
nobody remembers how to untie it

wrong.snack: very monkey of them. but no.
wrong.knot: knots were fine. the length wasn’t.

game.right: YES. he forgot the length tied round his own waist. so he made up the gap with himself.

end.line: the cane fell short, so a monkey king stretched his own body across the gap.
end.l2: so the king became the bridge.

cliff.s1: next: a zen teacher gets blamed.
cliff.s2: for something he didn’t do. he answers with three words.

share: archers at dawn. one monkey king. one leap. a jataka tale on infinite hill
